description: PowSyBl Diagram is an LF Energy project component for visualising power-system network models. It generates SVG network-area diagrams and single-line diagrams from the PowSyBl Core Network representation. Voltage levels, electrical nodes, transformers and lines can be shown with configurable labels, CSS styling and active or reactive power values. Single-line views support node/breaker and bus/breaker topology with automatic, relative-position or CGMES diagram layouts. Coverage is global and user-defined, with no fixed grid, observation period or numerical time step. Public Java source and linked tutorials/API documentation are free under MPL-2.0. A limitation is that network-area layout emphasises electrical structure and can differ substantially from physical geography; the diagrams do not verify engineering correctness or model calibration. Compatible PowSyBl components are needed to prepare the input representation. The package supports inspection and communication of grid-simulation configurations and results around the catalogue's PowSyBl platform (platform-powsybl). That parent record does not explicitly include this diagram component. No network file was downloaded or rendered during this review.
